data.title: Ethereum Layer 2 Blast Is Shutting Down: What Happens to Your Coins?
data.description: Blast, an Ethereum (CRYPTO:ETH) layer 2 network that attracted $2.3 billion in deposits by its February 2024 launch, is shutting down. On October 2, 2026, the team announced that the cost of running the network exceeds its earnings and that there’s no viable solution to fix this. Users will have until October 26 to withdraw […]
